motion_rule: camera slides sideways along the rail nonstop, fur and bare hangers tear past every frame; the moth acts in every beat, side moths work at the lens; her head over a third of frame, new shot size each beat; motion crosses frame
character: ONE grey-beige moth, rumpled, plump belly, two thirds of frame height; rides a wooden hanger rolling along the rail to the last frame, never dismounts; napkin at her collar
second_characters: ONE courier moth on a hanger rushing the other way at the lens with envelopes, 1.40-1.95 and 4.00-4.60; ONE fat neighbour moth surfacing from the fur at the lens, 2.60-3.25 and 7.60-8.10
props: ONE white paper bill tape with ДОЛГ in black capitals across it; ONE gnawed mink sleeve in her paw until 5.25, then the coat she snatches off its hanger
prop_continuity: tape grows from a scrap at 0.85, whips round her chest at 1.95, drags as a tail sweeping the fur from 5.25; the right rail behind her is bare hangers only from 1.40
environment: narrow cloakroom aisle, white walls, pale mink coats fur to fur on the left rail, bare hangers on the right
light_events: tall windows both sides, dust flaring in the beams; a flare sweeps her back at 4.60 and 8.10

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: female voice, whining and well-fed, biting off every word, 4.5 syllables per second
audio.pronunciation: me-NYA, GLO-zhut, sche-TA, dol-GI, TAK-zhe, PA-ra, SHUB, NOR-ki, u-ZHE, poch-TI, do-YE-la
audio.pacing: 0.00-1.95, 1.95-4.00 and 4.60-7.00 each on one breath; after 7.00 no words, sfx continue
audio.lip_sync: jaw opens on every syllable, even while chewing
audio.sfx: rustling fur, squeaking hangers, crunching fabric, hissing paper, envelopes at the lens

she rips the tape off a coat as she rolls past, the coat spinning away behind her, jaw works
courier rushes past at the lens; she swings the tape at him sideways, jaw works
she throws a loop of tape sideways and it whips round her chest, jaw works
neighbour surfaces from the fur at the lens; she shoves a bare hanger past her, jaw works
she bites the sleeve and shakes her head sideways, jaw works
courier rolls right past the lens, dropping envelopes across frame
she flings the gnawed sleeve sideways out of frame, jaw works
she snatches a coat off its hanger on the fly and swings it across frame, jaw works
she throws the coat over her shoulder and tears a strip of fur off it sideways, jaw works
she kicks a row of bare hangers as she rolls, they tear past jangling
neighbour slaps a bare hanger into her paws as both roll past the lens
moth bites into the coat at the lens and rips a strip of fur sideways with her teeth
moth shakes her head across frame, the tuft of mink and the tape sweeping the lens

must_appear: pale coats on the left rail, bare hangers on the right wherever she has passed; ДОЛГ tape from 0.85 and growing; every line spoken, last word before 7.00; from 8.10 she rips fur at the lens
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, digits, a price card, garbled or misspelled words, Latin letters, slow motion, foreign accent, a closed jaw while speaking, an empty corridor, a still hero at the end, a hero holding onto a hanging coat, vertical flight, English speech
